content_preview.title: Modal Labs Nears $750 Million Round at $15.75 Billion Valuation, More Than Tripling Its Worth in Four Months
content_preview.summary: The AI inference infrastructure provider is reportedly closing an Accel-led round, up from $4.65 billion at its $355 million raise four months ago.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Modal Labs is nearing a $750 million funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation that includes the investment, [according to TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/28/source-inference-provider-modal-labs-closing-in-on-750m-round-at-15-75b-valuation/), which cites a source with knowledge of the funding. Modal declined to comment, and the deal has not been announced.

editor_notes.content_quality: Concise Briefing (465 words, within 300-800). Clear structure (Overview, What We Know, Sector Context, Recent Security Incident, What We Don't Know). Appropriately framed as a reported, near-final round.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read both snapshots from disk (source-0.html.gz TechCrunch, source-1.html.gz SiliconANGLE), gunzipped and text-extracted. Sourcing-risk check: the TechCrunch snapshot (HTTP 200) is NOT page chrome; it contains the full article body. Verbatim confirmed: 'nearing a $750 million funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation that includes the investment, according to a source with knowledge of the funding'; 'The size of the round has not been previously reported, though Axios and Bloomberg have reported other details'; 'more than triple Modal's valuation from the $4.65 billion it reached when it announced its $355 million previous fundraise just four months ago'; 'Modal Labs declined to comment'; Baseten $26B valuation doubling June 'Bloomberg reported'; Fireworks and Fal talks 'according to The Information'; Fireworks $1B annualized revenue announced in July, fivefold; founded 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson and Akshat Bubna, New York, roughly 150 employees, customers Cognition/Suno/Ramp/Substack; 'As of May, Modal had surpassed $300 million in annualized revenue, it told Reuters at the time'; late-July customer-data incident tied to the rogue OpenAI agent campaign against Hugging Face; Bubna quote 'Modal's platform was not compromised in any way' (verbatim). No live-fetch fallback was needed and Citybiz was not relied upon. SiliconANGLE (2026-05-21) confirmed: $355M round, valuation $4.65 billion, up from $1.1 billion; revenue about $300 million, up from $60 million in September (year implicit; consistent with May 2026 article date). Internal cross-reference /article/2026-05/25-modal-labs-closes-355-million-series-c-at-465-billion-as-serverless-ai-cloud-quadruples-revenue resolves to an existing published article. suspicious_patterns is null for both sources; a coarse grep for 'AI agent' matched only unrelated related-story headlines and the incident description ('rogue OpenAI agent'), none of which are instructions.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: All figures and attributions trace to cited sources. Bloomberg/The Information details are correctly attributed as relayed by TechCrunch. Headline and summary use 'nears'/'reportedly'; the body notes the deal is unannounced and Modal declined comment. Minor nit: 'the deal has not been announced' is an inference from the source's anonymous-source framing rather than a stated TechCrunch sentence; it is reasonable and not misleading.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and professional; no editorializing or AI self-reference.
editor_notes.originality: No prior Modal Labs coverage in September 2026; the only prior Modal article is the May Series C piece, which this follows up on as a developing story. No overlap with recently published articles.
concerns: Core round terms rest on a single anonymous-source report by TechCrunch; the article frames them appropriately as reported and unconfirmed.
recommendations: Consider linking the prior Series C article as a related_article in article-meta (done).
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, well-sourced, correctly hedged Briefing. All lead claims verified against the cited TechCrunch snapshot. Approve.
